purpose: dedication of a stone water conduit/reservoir (śilādroṇī) for the benefit of all sentient beings
notes: The inscription is damaged and metrically/grammatically irregular. It records the donation of a śilādroṇī by a nun (bhikṣuṇī). It is uncertain whether 'dayā' is the personal name Dayā or refers to compassion (dayā/dayayā), and whether 'pauna pānyāṃ' represents a toponym in the locative or a corrupt name.
